patternsPremium.whyDescription: Some behaviours may relieve anxiety in the moment while keeping the cycle going over time. Confia helps you observe these patterns and discover whether small changes are associated with better well-being.
patternsPremium.assessmentIntro: Identify behaviours you want to understand better. You do not need to eliminate them — first, we get to know them.
patternsPremium.habitName: What behaviour do you want to observe?
patternsPremium.category: Which area does it belong to?
patternsPremium.motivation: How important is it for you to change this behaviour?
patternsPremium.dailyIntro: Record only what happened today. There are no right or wrong answers.
patternsPremium.intensityQuestion: How present was this behaviour today?
patternsPremium.evolutionDescription: Compare your patterns with your well-being and look for changes over time.
patternsPremium.wellbeingChartDesc: Average of morning and afternoon check-ins
patternsPremium.negativeRelationship: On days when this behaviour was more present, your well-being tends to be lower.
patternsPremium.positiveRelationship: On days when this behaviour was more present, your well-being tends to be higher.
patternsPremium.noClearRelationship: There is not yet a clear relationship between this behaviour and your well-being.
patternsPremium.analysisIntro: Confia found some patterns in the data you recorded.
patternsPremium.negativeInsight: Your records suggest a possible relationship between «{{habit}}» and days with lower well-being.
patternsPremium.positiveInsight: Your data suggests a possible relationship between «{{habit}}» and your well-being.
patternsPremium.stillLearningTitle: Confia is still learning about you
patternsPremium.stillLearningDescription: Keep recording your habits and well-being. The more days you have, the better we can identify personal trends.
patternsPremium.analysisDisclaimer: This analysis shows associations in your records. It does not prove that a behaviour directly causes a change in well-being.
patternsPremium.noHabitsTitle: First, let's get to know your patterns
patternsPremium.noHabitsDescription: Add at least one behaviour you want to observe over the next few days.
patternsPremium.notEnoughDataTitle: We still need a few days
patternsPremium.notEnoughDataDescription: Record your behaviours daily. Then you will start to see trends.
